title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
About the Company

Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.

Company Website:

About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors

Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.

We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

Compensation & Benefits

This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.

Why Join Us

Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you've ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‐conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses.

They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‐functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‐tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‐term profitability.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‐functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‐functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‐quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‐tender and post‐award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‐practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‐solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‐site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: Remote Commercial Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side.
  • Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes.
  • Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house.
  • Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination.
  • Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective.
  • Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise.
  • Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Desenvolvedor de Mecânica - Aeronáutico
description:
A AEL está em busca de um(a) profissional para integrar o time de Engenharia Mecânica como Desenvolvedor de Mecânica - Aeronáutico. Aqui, você fará parte de um ambiente movido por tecnologia de ponta, atuando no desenvolvimento de projetos voltados para sistemas aviônicos e estruturas aeronáuticas. Nessa posição, você será responsável por criar soluções inovadoras, garantindo qualidade, precisão e conformidade com os requisitos técnicos e regulatórios, em um contexto de alta complexidade do setor de Defesa.

Nessa posição você terá o desafio de:

  • Desenvolvimento de projetos 3D e detalhamento 2D, de peças e conjuntos aviônicos, incluindo instalações de equipamentos eletrônicos em estruturas aeronáuticas;
  • Projeto de modernização de aeronaves;
  • Suportar a produção, atuando como interface entre áreas internas (operações, compras, etc.);
  • Auxiliar em testes de qualificação (ensaios térmicos e dinâmicos) e testes de integração.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Inglês avançado para condução de reuniões e apresentações intercompany;
  • Sólida experiência com algum CAD 3D, preferencialmente em Solidworks, NX Cad ou Catia V5;
  • Experiência de pelo menos dois anos em projetos de P&D;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens internacionais;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas PDM e PLM é desejável;
  • Conhecimento em análise estrutural é diferencial;
  • Experiência com materiais compósitos (fibras de carbono e vidro, estruturas em sanduíche) é diferencial.

O que a AEL te proporciona

  • Política de horários flexível e modelo híbrido: Atuamos com banco de horas e alguns dias de atuação remota, proporcionando uma rotina flexível
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Custos de adesão subsidiados pela AEL
  • Seguro de Vida: Zelamos pela sua proteção e de seus familiares
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefícios Flash e contamos com refeitório na empresa
  • Auxílio Mobilidade/Vale Transporte: Facilitamos o seu deslocamento diário com opções que se adaptam à sua rotina
  • Estimulamos o equilíbrio da vida pessoal e profissional: Temos um calendário anual de feriados e férias coletivas, visando estimular o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional
  • Celebramos nossas conquistas: temos diversas ações de confraternização e reconhecimento, celebrando os atingimentos da jornada
  • Auxílio idioma: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento através do aprimoramento em inglês
  • Prêmio de fim de ano: Reconhecemos os desafios atingidos ao fim do ano
  • Incentivos à prática de atividades físicas: Investimos na sua saúde através de grupos de corrida, ginástica funcional e ginástica laboral
  • Bebê AEL: Celebramos a chegada de novos membros das famílias
  • Empresa Cidadã: Contamos com dias estendidos de licença maternidade e paternidade

Sobre a AEL Sistemas

Excelência faz parte da nossa cultura. Está em tudo o que fazemos, nos processos, na forma de ser e inovar. A cada dia, o nosso potencial criativo se materializa na tecnologia de ponta que desenvolvemos. Aqui valorizamos as relações humanas, amigáveis e plurais, identificando os momentos em que é preciso seguir a formalidade e reforçar a nossa experiência.

Somos uma empresa genuinamente brasileira. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Assessor de Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um Assessor de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica no relacionamento com clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras alinhadas aos objetivos e ao perfil de cada investidor.

Na EQI, o início da carreira é fortemente focado na formação de pessoas, com um modelo educacional estruturado e progressão de aprendizado intensiva. Esse processo é constantemente avaliado, sendo atrativo tanto para profissionais em fase inicial ou em transição de carreira, quanto para aqueles já experientes que buscam uma instituição que valoriza educação, resultado e evolução contínua.

Etapa Inicial Desde o primeiro dia, o profissional já atua como Assessor de Investimentos, inserido em um modelo de formação intenso e educacional.

  • Onboarding Integração à cultura EQI, ferramentas e fundamentos técnicos e comerciais necessários para a atuação.
  • Desenvolvimento Comercial Atuação prática com foco em prospecção, geração de oportunidades e fortalecimento das habilidades de relacionamento.
  • Consolidação da Atuação Após o período de adaptação e com a consolidação dos resultados esperados, o(a) Assessor(a) passa a receber carteira de clientes EQI e inicia sua atuação completa, exercitando o modelo de assessoria da EQI com métricas e indicadores que acompanharão ao longo de toda a carreira.
  • Plano de Carreira O desenvolvimento começa já na formação e evolui de forma estruturada, com avaliações em cada etapa e oportunidades de crescimento até posições de maior senioridade.

O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

  • Fit Cultural;
  • Certificação CPA-20 (CPA +CPROR), CEA (CPROI) ou CFP (ou interesse em tirar);
  • Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Disponibilidade em tempo integral (100% presencial);
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).

Por que escolher a EQI?

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado;
  • Suporte e acompanhamento integral das lideranças no dia a dia;
  • Feedbacks estruturados;
  • Sistemas avançados e tecnologias de ponta;
  • Plataformas próprias de desenvolvimento profissional (EaD) com mais de 350 treinamentos disponíveis (habilidades técnicas e comportamentais);
  • Possibilidade real de Partnership.

Informações adicionais

VA/VR de R$ 1.918

Plano de Saúde

Wellhub

Descontos com parceiro Benup

+ Outros benefícios que você descobre ao decorrer do processo.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company's toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You'll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 4+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

  • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Director of Procurement
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company's business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision's smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world's largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

Key Responsibilities

  • Fully responsible for the company's procurement in the Latin American region, and for developing and optimizing regional procurement strategies.
  • Lead market research in Latin America, analyze regional industry trends, supplier capabilities, and market risks to support the company's procurement strategy and project decision-making.
  • Manage and deeply maintain the regional supplier ecosystem, regularly evaluate the quality of suppliers' products and services, and drive improvements in key supply chain systems.
  • Guide and participate in the negotiation, review, and management of procurement contracts to ensure they are legal and compliant, protecting the company's interests.
  • Develop and implement procurement cost control plans, continuously drive improvements in procurement processes, efficiency, and cost optimization to enhance project profitability.
  • Build and improve regional procurement processes, policies, and systems, promoting standardized procurement and digital advancement to achieve compliant and transparent processes.
  • Collaborate with delivery, operations, and other relevant departments, as well as headquarters resources, to effectively support the smooth execution of regional projects.

Job Requirements

  • 1. Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in a science or engineering major.
  • 2. Over 10 years of experience in procurement or supply chain management, with required experience in procurement in Latin America.
  • 3. Thorough understanding of procurement processes and cross-cultural supplier management, capable of independently leading procurement negotiations and maintaining supplier relationships.
  • 4. Strong cost awareness and data analysis abilities, with proven success in procurement cost control.
  • 5. Strong communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills, able to efficiently handle regional procurement emergencies.
  • 6. Highly responsible, self-motivated, big-picture thinker, able to handle pressure at key delivery milestones.
  • 7. Proficient in English, able to frequently travel across Latin American countries.
  • 8. Experience in building and managing procurement systems in the Latin American region for Fortune 500, international energy, or engineering companies is preferred.

title: Cost Controller
description:
Our organization is hiring for an experienced Cost Controller in Rio. The Cost Controller is responsible for managing and monitoring project and operational costs to ensure alignment with budget and financial objectives. The role includes preparing and maintaining budgets and forecasts, conducting cost and variance analysis, tracking expenditures, identifying financial risks and cost-saving opportunities, and providing accurate financial reporting to support decision-making. The Cost Controller works closely with operational and finance teams to enhance cost visibility, ensure compliance with financial controls and company policies, and drive financial performance through effective cost management and resource utilization.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Develop, maintain, and monitor project and operational budgets
  • Prepare periodic forecasts and analyze budget versus actual performance
  • Track and control costs to ensure adherence to approved budgets
  • Perform detailed variance analysis and provide explanations for cost deviations
  • Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, dashboards, and management summaries
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities and recommend corrective actions to improve financial performance
  • Monitor project commitments, accruals, and expenditures to ensure financial accuracy
  • Collaborate with operational, project, procurement, and finance teams to support cost management initiatives

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in cost control, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, or project accounting
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial reporting skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics)
  • Knowledge of budgeting, cost management, variance analysis, and financial controls
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Ability to identify financial risks and cost-saving opportunities
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities
  • Advanced English proficiency in multinational environments
  • Professional certifications (CMA, CPA, CIMA, ACCA, or equivalent) are a plus

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
Our client is a fast-growing pioneer in the agricultural robotics space, revolutionizing the farming industry by designing and building advanced, autonomous farm machines. By utilizing cutting-edge computer vision and machine learning, their technology enables farmers to understand and manage fields at a plant-by-plant level.

Backed as an independent subsidiary of one of the world's most respected global agricultural machinery giants, they combine the agile, fast-paced environment of a high-tech startup with the massive scaling power of an industry leader. Their mission is to improve global food production, increase farming profitability, and protect the environment by dramatically reducing pesticide use.

THE ROLE: FIELD APPLICATION ENGINEER (BRAZIL)

We are seeking a hands-on Field Application Engineer based in Brazil to help develop, support, and maintain next-generation "smart" farm machines. In this role, you will be the bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will carry out in-field product testing, troubleshoot complex electro-mechanical systems, and provide the crucial feedback needed to drive continuous product development.

This is an immediate-start opportunity with exciting potential to travel to the United States during the Brazilian off-season.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Field Application Engineer, your primary focus will be supporting smart machinery performance directly in the field:

  • In-Field Testing: Carry out hardware, software, and machine vision field tests on mechatronic agricultural machinery, providing detailed execution reports and documentation.
  • Technical Support: Collect field data, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical issues on-site.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the vital link between customers, product management, agronomy, and engineering to communicate real-world user needs.
  • Documentation: Assist engineering teams in creating comprehensive product documentation, user guides, and instructional materials.
  • Systems Management: Track and manage recurring technical issues from initial identification to final resolution.
  • Logistics & Setup: Perform hands-on setup, maintenance, calibration, and transport of field-testing equipment as required.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Minimum Requirements:

  • Language Skills: Full professional fluency in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Agriculture, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Experience supporting, troubleshooting, or maintaining complex agricultural electro-mechanical systems (large machinery).
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose complex systems spanning hardware, software, and mechanical components.
  • Communication & Mindset: Excellent customer-facing skills with a collaborative, team-oriented attitude.
  • Mobility: Valid driver's license with a safe driving record, and a strong willingness to travel frequently to agricultural fields.

Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred but not required):

  • Familiarity with Linux environments and basic script programming.
  • Experience in designing and executing Design Verification Testing (DVT).
  • Basic programming/scripting skills in Python.
  • Familiarity with CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is an active, hands-on role in an outdoor environment. You should be comfortable standing, walking, bending, kneeling, and climbing in various weather conditions (hot and cold).
  • Ability to frequently lift/move items up to 25 pounds (and occasionally up to 50 pounds).
  • Strong visual acuity (including color vision and depth perception) to work with advanced camera and machine vision systems.

WHAT'S ON OFFER

  • Competitive Compensation Package with a highly collaborative, supportive, and forward-thinking work culture.
  • Fully Equipped: All tools, specialized equipment, and work vehicles are provided by the employer.
  • Travel Covered: 100% reimbursement for all work-related travel expenses.
  • Global Exposure: Unique opportunities for international collaboration and travel to US headquarters.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

title: Tax Manager
description:
Sobre nós

Somos a Forvis Mazars, com mais de 80 anos de expertise global e mais de 20 anos de presença no Brasil. Presente em mais de 100 países, nossos colaboradores estão a postos para apoiar sua empresa com serviços de Auditoria, Consultoria e BPO reconhecidos pelo mercado no Brasil e no mundo.

title: Gerente de Quiosque (São José SC)
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!

Somos uma empresa de igualdade de oportunidades. Isso significa que, ao tomar decisões sobre a carreira de nossos colaboradores, nossas principais considerações são sua capacidade de realizar seu trabalho e se desenvolver em suas funções.

Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.

Nós recrutamos pessoas de mente positiva que compartilham nossos valores fundamentais e nosso compromisso com Sustentabilidade.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Garantir que 100% da equipe realize os treinamentos online. Coordenar a virada da operação a cada campanha dentro dos prazos e seguindo orientações da MMP (material de merchandising promocional) , além de manter a loja atrativa para o cliente (organização, precificação, limpeza, estrutura)

Participar das reuniões, construção de plano de ação, trabalhando estrategicamente no atingimento dos resultados. Buscar desenvolver o time em busca de um sucessor para a sua posição

title: Advogado(a) - Núcleo de Laudos e Investigação Patrimonial
description:
Você tem perfil investigativo, olhar analítico e paixão por inteligência jurídica voltada à recuperação de crédito de alta complexidade?

Procuramos um(a) profissional para integrar nosso Núcleo de Laudos e Investigação Patrimonial. A posição envolve uma atuação verdadeiramente multidisciplinar, unindo Direito Processual Civil, Empresarial/Societário, Registral e Notarial para entregar efetividade real aos nossos clientes.

Suas principais missões:

  • Conduzir investigações patrimoniais profundas de pessoas físicas e jurídicas (mapeamento de ativos, relações societárias, vínculos familiares/empresariais e sucessão);
  • Analisar criticamente matrículas de imóveis, escrituras, procurações, documentos societários e acervos processuais;
  • Identificar indícios de grupo econômico, confusão patrimonial, sucessão empresarial, fraude à execução, simulação e blindagem patrimonial;
  • Construir teses e avaliar hipóteses de desconsideração da personalidade jurídica e responsabilização de terceiros;
  • Analisar processos de Recuperação Judicial e Falência, mapeando informações patrimoniais e processuais relevantes para a estratégia do credor;
  • Elaborar laudos e relatórios técnico-jurídicos de alto impacto (incluindo linhas do tempo, organogramas societários e mapas de relacionamento);
  • Redigir peças processuais estratégicas voltadas às investigações e medidas executivas.

O que buscamos:

  • OAB ativa e regular;
  • Experiência sólida em execução, cumprimento de sentença e incidentes correlatos;
  • Domínio na análise de matrículas imobiliárias, escrituras públicas e procurações;
  • Capacidade crítica para "ligar os pontos" em investigações complexas e traduzir dados em estratégia jurídica;

title: Analytics and Automation Specialist

This is a hands-on role covering everyday system hygiene through to building automated processes that reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.

The role is structured around three core service pillars, plus a growing automation function.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advanced Looker Studio usage and setup

  • Excellent English (written and verbal) — essential

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing Google Ads campaigns and reporting on channel performance

Working Arrangements

  • Standard client-facing hours are Monday–Friday, 9:00am–1:00pm AEST, excluding public holidays, unless otherwise agreed.

Things You Should Know About SOMO

title: Analista PPCM Junior - Florestal
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Planejar e programar as ordens de manutenção da frota florestal, considerando demanda operacional, capacidade de execução, criticidade dos ativos e disponibilidade de recursos.
  • Elaborar e atualizar a programação semanal de manutenção (S+1), organizando as ordens conforme prioridades, janelas operacionais e capacidade das equipes executoras.
  • Acompanhar a execução das atividades programadas, identificando desvios, pendências e necessidades de reprogramação.
  • Planejar ordens de manutenção corretivas programáveis, preventivas, campanhas e demais intervenções definidas pela área.
  • Detalhar as ordens de manutenção, identificando escopo, materiais, serviços, mão de obra, ferramentas, documentação e demais recursos necessários à execução.
  • Controlar e acompanhar o backlog de manutenção, avaliando prioridades, restrições, prazos e oportunidades de programação.
  • Atualizar e acompanhar o status das ordens de manutenção nos sistemas aplicáveis, assegurando a confiabilidade e a rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Realizar interface com Operação, Manutenção, Engenharia, Suprimentos, Almoxarifado e demais áreas de apoio para alinhamento das atividades planejadas e programadas.
  • Acompanhar a disponibilidade de materiais e serviços necessários à execução das ordens, direcionando pendências às áreas responsáveis.
  • Monitorar e consolidar indicadores operacionais de manutenção, como aderência à programação, cumprimento dos planos, backlog e prazos das ordens.
  • Elaborar controles, relatórios e análises operacionais para suporte ao acompanhamento da carteira e à tomada de decisão da supervisão.
  • Participar de reuniões de programação, planejamento e acompanhamento, apresentando prioridades, restrições, desvios e encaminhamentos de sua carteira.
  • Contribuir para a padronização e a melhoria contínua dos processos de PPCM, identificando oportunidades de ganho na execução das rotinas.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos internos, requisitos de segurança, padrões de qualidade e diretrizes de gestão da manutenção.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de planejamento e controle de manutenção (ERP, MRP, SAP)
  • Excel intermediário
  • Rotinas de Programação e Planejamento de manutenção
  • Abertura, detalhamento, acompanhamento e controle de ordens de manutenção
  • Controle de backlog e programação semanal
  • Análise e consolidação de dados operacionais de manutenção

Desejável:

  • Manutenção de frotas e equipamentos pesados
  • Indicadores de manutenção: aderência, backlog, disponibilidade, MTBF e MTTR
  • Experiência em ambiente florestal, industrial ou agrícola
  • Power BI ou ferramenta similar de BI

Indicadores acompanhados

O profissional participará da consolidação e evolução de indicadores como:

Não é necessário que o candidato já domine todos esses indicadores. Espera-se capacidade analítica e disposição para aprendê-los progressivamente com o apoio da diretoria e da equipe.

  • Interesse ou experiência em Customer Success, atendimento, relacionamento ou pós-venda;

Não é necessário conhecer previamente o setor florestal. O conhecimento técnico será desenvolvido internamente.

Cultura e Desenvolvimento = Construímos Juntos e Juntas

title: Rewards Partner LATAM
description:
About the role

Leads the execution of the Total Rewards agenda across Latin America, translating strategy into impactful and scalable compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs that support Kerry's business and people priorities. This role partners closely with HR and business leaders to deliver market-competitive reward solutions, ensuring a seamless balance between employee experience, operational excellence, compliance, and cost effectiveness. Through strong stakeholder management, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement, the role drives consistent delivery, fosters cross-functional collaboration, and ensures Rewards programs create meaningful value for employees and the business.

Key responsibilities

Strategic Rewards Partner

  • Act as the trusted Rewards advisor to HR and business leaders across LATAM, translating global Rewards strategies into practical regional solutions that support business growth, talent priorities, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with HR Leadership Teams and business stakeholders to develop and execute Rewards programs that attract, retain, motivate, and engage talent while ensuring market competitiveness and internal equity.
  • Provide strategic guidance on compensation, benefits, recognition, incentive, and workforce planning matters, balancing business needs, employee experience, governance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Leverage market intelligence, analytics, and external benchmarking to identify trends, assess risks, and inform reward-related decisions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives, including restructures, acquisitions, integrations, and talent-related projects, ensuring Rewards considerations are effectively incorporated into business decisions.

Rewards Centre of Excellence Partner

  • Partner with Global Rewards and regional HR teams to implement and sustain Rewards programs, policies, frameworks, and governance across LATAM.
  • Drive the regional delivery of annual Rewards processes including salary reviews, incentive plans, market pricing, job architecture, pay transparency, and benefits governance.
  • Ensure Rewards programs remain compliant with local legislation, company policies, and regulatory requirements across the countries within scope.
  • Lead the assessment, design, and continuous improvement of Rewards programs to enhance employee value proposition, operational effectiveness, and cost management.
  • Develop and execute communication and change management strategies that improve understanding and adoption of Rewards programs among leaders, HR teams, and employees.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and coaching to HRBPs and people leaders on Rewards philosophy, policies, tools, and decision-making frameworks.

Business & Operational Execution

  • Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, Finance, Legal, Payroll, Global Rewards, and external vendors to ensure successful implementation of Rewards initiatives.
  • Support data-driven decision making through analysis, insights, and recommendations related to compensation, benefits, workforce costs, and talent outcomes.
  • Monitor Rewards program effectiveness through KPIs, market benchmarking, employee feedback, and governance reviews, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Drive high-quality execution of Rewards projects and processes, ensuring consistency, service excellence, and alignment with regional and global priorities.
  • Contribute to the development of regional guidelines, policies, and governance frameworks that enable scalable and sustainable Rewards practices across LATAM.

Qualifications and skills

  • A Bachelor's degree (Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business or other applicable field)
  • Minimum of ten (10) years broad based human resources experience, with significant experience at influencing; Experience in the food/flavours manufacturing industry desirable
  • English, Portuguese and Spanish language capability (fluent in writing, speaking)

About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

description:
Pionerismo que nos orgulha, responsabilidade que nos guia.

Somos a Mineração Serra Verde e operamos uma unidade integrada de mineração e processamento de terras raras em Minaçu-GO. Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

title: Financial Planning Manager
description:
Turn recurring reporting into a decision system.

Own management reporting, KPI dashboards, and forward-looking analysis for US leadership teams.

This is not a task-execution role. You will be expected to own outcomes, exercise judgment, improve how the work gets done, and communicate directly with senior stakeholders.

About MAVI

MAVI is an invite-only network connecting high-performing finance and accounting professionals with fast-growing US companies. Members are assessed for technical capability, communication, ownership, and leadership potential. Through MAVI, you work directly with finance leaders, own meaningful outcomes, and build a track record that can lead to increasingly senior opportunities.

What you'll own

  • Build and maintain executive, board, and investor reporting packages.
  • Develop KPI dashboards that connect operating metrics with financial outcomes.
  • Produce variance analysis and forward-looking commentary for monthly business reviews.
  • Partner with data, accounting, and functional teams to improve source-data quality.
  • Automate recurring reporting and reduce manual spreadsheet work.
  • Translate trends into concise actions, risks, and opportunities.

What makes you a fit

  • 6+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, business intelligence, or management reporting.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability; Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools are valuable.
  • Experience building reporting for executives, boards, or investors.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, KPIs, and variance analysis.
  • Able to distinguish meaningful signals from reporting noise.
  • Excellent written communication and comfort working with US stakeholders.

The seniority bar

  • You independently structure ambiguous business questions and turn them into decision-ready financial analysis.
  • You challenge assumptions constructively and can defend your recommendation with executives and non-finance leaders.
  • You build models and reporting frameworks that others can use—not one-off analyses that depend entirely on you.
  • You understand the business implication behind the numbers and communicate a clear point of view.

What success looks like

  • Leadership receives consistent, trusted reporting with less manual effort.
  • KPI and financial narratives clearly identify what changed and what to do next.
  • Data-quality issues are surfaced and resolved at the source.

Why join now

Deliver strongly in this scope and build toward FP&A Manager or Finance Business Partner opportunities across the MAVI network. Compensation is USD-denominated and aligned with experience, scope, and location. Working hours are designed around local schedules with reasonable, clearly defined overlap for US stakeholders.

• SOBRE NÓS

A ZAWA é uma empresa em crescimento contínuo no setor de importação e e-commerce, com atuação consolidada há mais de oito anos nos principais marketplaces do país. Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios:

  • Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.
  • Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.
  • Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.
  • Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.
  • Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.

title: [Tech] Engenharia Especialista de Dados e IA
description:

A atuação é principalmente consultiva. Os times de produtos internos conduzem a implementação, enquanto você orienta as decisões arquiteturais, compartilha boas práticas e contribui para ampliar o uso de dados e IA nas soluções TOTVS.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir o onboarding de novos times nas plataformas de dados;

title: Production Engineer - Wireless Industrialization and Tax Processes Specialist
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Production Engineer or Industrialization Specialist to support the development and implementation of local manufacturing and assembly strategies for ZTE's telecommunications products in Brazil.

The primary focus of this position will be to evaluate and enable the local production of Wireless RAN and Microwave (MW) equipment, including radio units, baseband units, antennas, transmission equipment, cabinets, power systems, accessories, and related components.

This professional will act as a key interface among Engineering, Product Management, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Logistics, Finance, local manufacturing partners, and ZTE's global teams.

The position requires a combination of industrial engineering, product-cost analysis, tax knowledge, and project coordination. The professional will be responsible for developing feasible local-production models, ensuring compliance with Brazilian industrial and tax regulations, and evaluating the effects of the Brazilian Tax Reform on manufacturing costs, tax credits, sourcing strategies, and product competitiveness.

Main Responsibilities

Local Production and Industrialization

  • Evaluate Wireless RAN and Microwave product families for potential local manufacturing, assembly, integration, configuration, testing, and repair in Brazil.
  • Develop industrialization strategies for radio units, baseband equipment, antennas, microwave radios, indoor and outdoor units, cabinets, power systems, and related telecom products.
  • Analyze different production models, including local manufacturing, outsourced manufacturing, contract manufacturing, CKD/SKD assembly, and partial localization of components.
  • Coordinate the implementation of local production projects from feasibility study through pilot production and mass production.
  • Define production workflows, assembly sequences, testing procedures, quality checkpoints, required tooling, labor demand, and factory capacity.
  • Prepare industrial process flowcharts, work instructions, technical reports, and project documentation.
  • Support prototype, pilot, first-article, and production-validation activities.
  • Monitor production performance, lead time, yield, quality indicators, manufacturing costs, and corrective-action plans.

Product Localization and Cost Analysis

  • Review product BOMs to identify opportunities for local sourcing, component substitution, process simplification, and cost reduction.
  • Develop localization roadmaps for selected Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Perform make-or-buy analyses and compare imported-product costs with local-production scenarios.
  • Prepare business cases covering investment requirements, production volume, manufacturing costs, tax impacts, logistics costs, and expected financial returns.
  • Identify Brazilian suppliers and manufacturing partners capable of meeting ZTE's technical, quality, cost, capacity, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate technical alignment between Brazilian suppliers, outsourced factories, and ZTE's global R&D and product teams.
  • Support negotiations with contract manufacturers and monitor their operational and contractual performance.

PPB, Regulatory Compliance and Incentives

  • Analyze and implement applicable Basic Productive Process (PPB) requirements for telecommunications and electronic products.
  • Evaluate industrial and regional incentive structures, including projects involving SUFRAMA and the Manaus Free Trade Zone, when applicable.
  • Monitor compliance with production stages, local-content requirements, investment commitments, documentation, and traceability obligations.
  • Support applications, technical projects, reports, and evidence required by government authorities and incentive programs.
  • Ensure alignment among BOM structure, manufacturing processes, import records, production orders, inventories, and tax documentation.
  • Support ANATEL-related product-compliance activities when they interact with industrialization, local configuration, or product modifications.
  • Assist internal and external audits and inspections conducted by SUFRAMA, Receita Federal, SEFAZ, and other regulatory authorities.

Tax Processes and Brazilian Tax Reform

  • Evaluate the tax impacts of local production versus importation for Wireless RAN and Microwave products.
  • Support the correct classification of products, components, kits, and raw materials under the NCM.
  • Coordinate the preparation and validation of the FCI – Import Content Statement, when applicable.
  • Work closely with the Tax team to ensure the correct application and recovery of tax credits throughout the manufacturing and supply chain.
  • Analyze the effects of Brazil's Tax Reform on industrialization projects, particularly the transition from the current tax system to CBS and IBS.
  • Assess how the new tax-credit model may affect product costs, local sourcing, contract manufacturing, inventory flows, transfers, imports, sales, and customer pricing.
  • Monitor the coexistence of legacy taxes and the new consumption-tax system during the transition period.
  • Support adaptations to ERP, costing, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, and tax-control processes required by the Tax Reform.
  • Analyze the effects of ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, CBS, IBS and, when applicable, the Selective Tax and regional tax incentives on industrial projects.
  • Maintain documentation and calculation models that allow ZTE to compare tax burdens and credit utilization under different production and sourcing scenarios.
  • Work with Tax, Finance, IT, and ERP teams to ensure the traceability of tax credits from component acquisition through production and final sale.
  • Monitor regulatory changes that may affect PPB rules, Manaus Free Trade Zone incentives, local manufacturing, imported content, or telecom-equipment taxation.

Systems, Inventory and Process Integration

  • Support the configuration and continuous improvement of industrial, inventory, purchasing, costing, and tax processes in ERP systems.
  • Ensure consistency among engineering BOMs, production BOMs, purchase orders, import systems, warehouse balances, production orders, and accounting records.
  • Support integrations and reconciliations involving PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, import-management systems, and other internal platforms.
  • Identify process gaps that may generate incorrect inventory balances, tax-credit losses, production delays, or accounting inconsistencies.
  • Participate in automation, data-analysis, and artificial-intelligence initiatives aimed at improving industrial planning, tax controls, documentation, and operational productivity.

Project Management and Cross-functional Coordination

  • Lead cross-functional industrialization projects involving Engineering, Product, Procurement, Supply Chain, Tax, Finance, Logistics, Quality, IT, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Develop project schedules, define responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and report risks and progress to management.
  • Coordinate technical and commercial discussions with ZTE headquarters and international product teams.
  • Translate global product and manufacturing requirements into processes compatible with Brazilian industrial, tax, and regulatory conditions.
  • Present recommendations, business cases, risks, and project results to local and global leadership.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in industrialization, manufacturing engineering, production-process implementation, or local assembly of electronic or telecommunications products.
  • Experience with BOM analysis, production workflows, cost structures, and outsourced manufacturing.
  • Practical knowledge of Brazilian taxes and industrial regulations related to manufacturing, including ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, NCM, FCI, and PPB.
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its main operational impacts, especially CBS, IBS, tax-credit traceability, and the transition between tax systems.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including cost simulations, scenario analysis, reconciliations, and data processing.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering specifications, BOMs, production documents, tax legislation, and regulatory requirements.
  • Intermediate or advanced English for meetings, technical discussions, documentation, and interaction with ZTE's global teams.
  • Availability to visit suppliers, factories, warehouses, and production partners when required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with Wireless RAN, Microwave, telecommunications infrastructure, or radio-frequency equipment.
  • Knowledge of the architecture and main components of radio access and microwave-transmission systems.
  • Previous experience in the localization or nationalization of telecom or electronic products.
  • Experience with contract manufacturers, electronics manufacturing services, CKD/SKD operations, or outsourced assembly.
  • Experience with PPB projects, SUFRAMA, the Manaus Free Trade Zone, or other Brazilian industrial-incentive programs.
  • Knowledge of PROTHEUS, SAP, WMS, MES, PLM, or other ERP and manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with product-costing methodologies, standard cost, landed cost, and manufacturing variance analysis.
  • Experience with ANATEL certification processes or other telecom regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, process mapping, quality tools, or project-management methodologies.
  • Experience using business-intelligence, automation, data-analysis, or artificial-intelligence tools.
  • Knowledge of Mandarin Chinese will be considered an advantage.

Requirement:

  • 7 years of experience in implementation in production, quality, supply chain, industrialization and tax;
  • Graduated in Engineering;
  • Fluent English.

Aqui, cada voz conta e cada ideia tem o poder de impactar. Valorizamos a humildade, o respeito, o comprometimento e a coragem, construindo uma cultura onde a inovação floresce. Aqui, liderar é dar o exemplo, e é por isso que inspiramos um ambiente dinâmico onde tecnologia e talento se complementam.

Se você sonha grande, tem coragem de desafiar o convencional e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que acredita no poder da cocriação, junte-se a nós! Vamos, juntos, acreditar e cocriar um futuro brilhante, onde cada passo representa uma nova conquista!

title: Analista Sênior de Homologação (Segurança Veicular)
description:
Analista Sênior de Homologação (Segurança Veicular)

Na Hyundai Motor Brasil, como parte da equipe de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento, no setor de Regulamentação & Certificação, você terá a oportunidade de atuar nos processos de homologação e certificação de novos modelos, acompanhando de perto as regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor automotivo.

A posição também envolve interação com outras montadoras, órgãos governamentais e entidades do setor, contribuindo para discussões e acompanhamentos relacionados a novas regulamentações que poderão entrar em vigor nos próximos anos.

Principais atividades

  • Monitorar e analisar atualizações de normas e regulamentações que possam impactar os processos de homologação da Hyundai Motor Brasil;
  • Acompanhar as informações e os processos de homologação no SISCAT, realizando, quando necessário, a inserção e atualização de dados no sistema, bem como no SEI da SENATRAN;
  • Atuar como interface com órgãos e agentes externos, como SENATRAN, INMETRO, fornecedores e demais entidades relacionadas aos processos de homologação;
  • Acompanhar e interpretar normas e regulamentações internacionais, especialmente os requisitos de segurança veicular aplicáveis aos mercados europeu e norte-americano;
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas internas relacionadas à homologação, apoiando demandas decorrentes de novos lançamentos, alterações de produto e adequações regulatórias;
  • Acompanhar a preparação de informações e dados para elaboração de Budget Request relacionados aos processos de homologação;
  • Monitorar alterações na legislação e nas regulamentações brasileiras que possam impactar produtos atuais e futuros;
  • Participar de reuniões junto à ANFAVEA e AEA, representando oficialmente a Hyundai Motor Brasil em discussões relacionadas à regulamentação e homologação veicular.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês intermediário, sendo desejável nível avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em Homologação e/ou Regulamentação Automotiva;
  • Conhecimento de normas e regulamentações de segurança veicular nacionais e internacionais;
  • Experiência com processos de homologação junto à SENATRAN, INMETRO e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Conhecimento dos sistemas SISCAT e SEI.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em interação com ANFAVEA, AEA, montadoras, fornecedores e órgãos governamentais;
  • Vivência em projetos de lançamento de novos veículos e alterações de produto.

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

Nós lhe propomos:
